column7: Nói về số lượng của đồ vật
column10:
Pattern: There are + [number] + [plural noun]

Constraint:
- numbers: basic numbers (two, three, four, five)
- nouns: regular plural nouns (add -s) (locks, clocks, mops, pots)

column7: Nói về số lượng của đồ vật
column10:
Pattern: [number] + [plural noun]

Constraint:
- numbers: two, three, four, five
- nouns: regular plural nouns (add -s)
- noun type: simple objects/animals (monkeys, clocks, locks, pots)

column7: Câu chỉ định với đồ vật (That’s…)
column10:
Pattern: That is (That’s) + a/an + [singular countable noun]

Constraint:
- nouns: basic nouns (animals, objects, food)
- examples: monkey, mango, mouse

column7: Câu chỉ định với con người (That’s…)
column10:
Pattern: That is (That’s) + my + [noun]

Constraint:
- noun: people (family members: mother, father, sister, brother...)

column7: Câu nói hành động đang diễn ra
column10:
Pattern: [singular subject] + is (’s) + [verb-ing]

Constraint:
- subjects: he, she, it, the boy, the truck, the bus
- verbs: running, moving
- verb type: action verbs

column7: Câu yêu cầu sự chú ý (Look at ...)
column10:
Pattern: look at + the + [object noun]

Constraint:
- verb: look at (fixed)
- noun: objects/nature (lemons, leaf, lake)
- determiner: required ("the")

column7: Câu yêu cầu sự chú ý (Look at ...)
column10:
Pattern: look at + [person name]

Constraint:
- verb: look at (fixed)
- noun: proper names (Lucy, Bill, Nam)
- no determiner ("the" not used)

column7: Câu nói về hành động đang ăn
column10:
Pattern: [singular subject] + is (’s) + having + [food noun]

Constraint:
- subject:
  + pronouns (she, he)
  + proper names (Nam, Nick,..)
- verb: having (fixed)
- noun: food (noodles, nuts, bananas)

column7: Câu nói về tôi nhìn thấy gì
column10:
Pattern: I can see + a/an + [singular noun]

Constraint:
- subject: I
- modal: can (fixed)
- verb: see (fixed)
- noun: singular, countable (animals, toys)
- example: tiger, teddy bear, turtle, top

column7: Câu nói chỉ sự sở hữu
column10:
Pattern: [name] + has + a/an + [singular noun]

Constraint:
- subject: singular proper name (Tony, Nam, Bill...)
- verb: has (fixed)
- noun: singular, countable (toys, animals)

column7: Câu mệnh lệnh với bộ phận cơ thể
column10:
Pattern: point to + your + [body part]

Constraint:
- verb: point to (fixed, không tách "point")
- body part: hand, foot, head, hair
- possessive: your (fixed)

column7: Câu hỏi và trả lời số lượng (nâng cao)
column10:
Pattern: 
Q: How many + [plural noun] + can you see?
A: I can see + [number]

Link: A answers Q

Constraint:
- plural nouns only (windows, books, doors)
- number range: 1–10
- fixed chunk: "can you see"
- answer form: short answer (no noun repetition)

column7: Câu hỏi và trả lời số lượng (nâng cao)
column10:
Pattern:
Q: How many + [plural noun] + can you see?
A: I can see + [number] + [noun]

Link: A answers Q

Constraint:
- question noun: plural form only (windows, books, doors)
- answer noun:
  + singular when number = 1
  + plural when number > 1
- number range: 1–10
- fixed chunk: "can you see"
